d: Pale peach-colored hair is styled with long, flowing locks and a small bun on the side, featuring a single prominent ahoge and blunt-cut bangs. The eyes are a golden-amber shade with an expressive, wide-eyed look. Appearing as a teenager with a slender build, the character wears thin-rimmed glasses. The outfit consists of a white long-sleeved collared shirt under a maroon sleeveless jumper dress, accented by a teal ribbon tied at the chest.
